verdict: High bar: stock at consensus PT (~$482) with ±10.7% options premium baked in — only a material beat-and-raise in AI revenue above the $10.7B guide and a strong FQ3 AI outlook unlocks further upside

## AVGO earnings preview (reports tonight, Jun 3 AMC)

### 1. Expectations

Wall Street consensus sits at **~$22.1B revenue** (company guidance: $22.0B; range up to $22.9B across 37 analysts) and **~$2.40–$2.46 adj. EPS** (+52% YoY), with estimates revised +11% over the past 90 days. *(AlphaStreet, Jun 3 2026; HeyGoTrade, Jun 2026)*

The headline focal point is **AI semiconductor revenue, guided to $10.7B** for FQ2 — up ~140% YoY and ~27% sequentially from Q1's $8.4B. *(Broadcom Q1 FY2026 press release / SEC 8-K, Feb 2026)*

The real buy-side bar is higher than the guide: the Street reportedly wants **~25% sequential AI beat or a strong FQ3 raise** — implying AI revenue of $12–13B+ in FQ3 to keep the momentum narrative intact. *(HeyGoTrade; MarketBeat, Jun 2026)*

### 2. Technical Setup

At ~$482, AVGO trades near its **52-week high ($496)**, roughly **23% above its 50-day moving average** and ~38% above the 200-day MA (~$350) — an extended setup heading into a binary event. *(MacroTrends; 247WallSt, May 28 2026)*

**Options imply a ±~10.7% move** — nearly double the trailing 4-quarter average absolute post-earnings reaction of ~6.7%. *(TipRanks, Jun 3 2026)*

**Consensus PT: ~$477–$490** (Susquehanna raised to $490 Buy). Stock is already at or above the Street's average target — sustained upside from here requires a fresh wave of price-target hikes, which only happens on a clear beat-and-raise. *(TipRanks; Susquehanna, Jun 2026)*

### 3. What Matters Most

1. **AI revenue vs. the $10.7B Q2 guide** — the magnitude of any beat (or miss) sets the immediate tone.
2. **FQ3 revenue + AI guidance** — the single most important line; a sub-$11.5B AI FQ3 guide likely disappoints the buy-side even if Q2 lands in-line.
3. **Custom-ASIC / XPU customer commentary** — Broadcom has reportedly expanded to up to **6 hyperscale XPU customers** (Google, Meta, ByteDance, Anthropic, Fujitsu, OpenAI); any new customer disclosure or confirmation of the previously flagged fourth-customer $10B+ commitment is an incremental catalyst. Google remains the anchor (~50% of AI ASIC revenue); any Gemini TPU ramp update is closely watched. *(IBTimes; NegotiumInfinitum, 2026)*
4. **Backlog / booking visibility** — multi-year order commitments underpin the ~$96B FY2026 revenue consensus path.

### 4. Bull vs. Bear Going In

**Bull:** AI-ASIC demand is still in early innings; six hyperscale XPU customers and ~75% custom-silicon market share create a durable moat — a $13B+ FQ3 AI guide could trigger a fresh wave of analyst PT hikes toward $550+.

**Bear:** Stock enters the print at consensus PT with a ~10.7% options premium to overcome; any cautious hyperscaler capex tone or a FQ3 AI guide that merely meets — not beats — buy-side whispers risks a sharp reversion from an already-extended technical setup.
